tools.name: todo_list
tools.description: Manages a personal todo list stored in data/todo.json. Use this to add, view, read, complete, or delete tasks for the user. Each task has an id, title, optional due date, and a done status.

functions.add_todo: Creates a new task. Requires a title, date is optional (format: YYYY-MM-DD).
functions.view_todos: Prints all tasks in a table showing id, done status, date, and title.
functions.get_todo: Reads a single task by its id.
functions.complete_todo: Marks a task as done by its id.
functions.delete_todo: Deletes a task by its id.
